headline: Mistral releases huge open-weight AI model aimed at cybersecurity
summary: Mistral released weights for a new, trillion-parameter open AI model, which the French lab says matches or beats top Chinese open-weight models from DeepSeek and Z.ai at coding and cybersecurity tasks. Mistral also says the open release lets organizations control their own cyber defenses in ways closed models don't allow.
